bibliographic.title: Let's Eat
bibliographic.author: Julian Grant
bibliographic.description:
It's oh-fuck o'clock. You're hungry. The fridge is empty.

Almost empty.

Let's Eat is a short interactive fiction set in a city where the rain is acidic, the elevator is perpetually broken, and late-night food procurement has become a bureaucratic endurance sport.

Navigate the ruins of your own decision-making. Consult a radio that knows too much. Negotiate with the Lobby Scavenger Guild (Local 7). Descend 56 floors on foot. Question everything.

There's something in the fridge. It's been there a while.

A comedy of hunger, poor planning, and inevitability. Inspired by Terry Pratchett's footnotes and William Gibson's rain.

Content: mild language, existential dread, questionable food choices. Play time: 10–15 minutes. Endings: several. You'll know the right one when you get there.
